Commentary.Commentary: That's all from this series. We hope you enjoyed our coverage. England are in good shape and are looking ominous before the Champions Trophy. They will take on South Africa at home for an ODI series later this month and will like to hone their skills even more. On the other hand, Ireland couldn't really come to the fore but they are a talented side. They now head back to their country and are set to host New Zealand and Bangladesh for a Tri-Nation ODI series, starting from 12th May. Do join us for all the action in future. Till then, goodbye and cheers!

Man of the Match, Joe Root smiles and says that the wickets gave him more joy than the runs. Adds that it would be a good position to be in, if he is not required to bowl but it's nice to have an option always. Also says that it's been a slow start to the season for him but is happy to get a few runs under his belt. Admits that the series against South Africa will be a big challenge.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan says that the win in the last game was a more convincing one than today. Adds that he and Root rebuilt the innings after a good start and feels they can get more clinical as one of the top order batsmen should have carried on and scored a century. Praises Jonny Bairstow and Adil Rashid for adding quick runs towards the end. Admits that it's a good headache to have too many options on the bench. Thinks that the quality of cricket coming up is excellent and that's what they need in the build up to Champions Trophy. Feels it was not a very conducive wicket for Rashid but is extremely happy with the way Wood has returned from injury and performed.

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says that they were much improved today. Mentions that disappointment is the right word. Feels that the first half with the ball was good. Adds that if they had a couple of wickets towards the end, things could have been different. Credits Bairstow and Rashid for batting well to take England to a good total. Praises McCarthy and Chase for the way they bowled. Mentions that it is not an easy task and it could have been easy to hide away. Further credits the boys for coming out hard and fighting till the end. Ends by saying that there are four more games (in the upcoming tri-series at home) to go, hopefully they will keep improving.

A disciplined bowling effort on the whole from the hosts. Root was once again in the thick of things and picked up three crucial wickets. Plunkett was in great rhythm too and got three wickets as well. A commendable performance from England overall and they continue to look a prime contender for the upcoming Champions Trophy.

The Irish middle order faltered but it was their skipper, William Porterfield who was the lone man standing. He was patient but kept running out of partners. He was also smart in picking up the gaps and scored freely. With 108 needed to win in 60 deliveries, the tourists would have felt they were in with a chance. But Porterfield departed soon and that almost sealed the deal for the home side. The lower order was left with too much to do and they crumbled under pressure.

Another emphatic show from the Englishmen and they have clinched the ODI series convincingly. They were clinical in all departments of the game and outplayed the Irishmen hands down. However, the visitors started off the chase in a good manner. Stirling was looking ominous and produced some terrific stroke play. Perhaps, he got carried away and fell to Mark Wood. His dismissal allowed the hosts to put pressure on the visiting batsmen.

OUT! ENGLAND WIN BY 85 RUNS! Wood hurls in an inswinging yorker, right at the base of the stumps, too good for Dockrell as he fails to bring his bat down in time. The stumps are shattered and Wood jumps in joy. The English players are delighted!
Fuller on off, driven to the off side.
The batsman plays the pull-shot. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, Chase tries to defend but gets it away off the outside edge to backward point. A single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
FOUR! Edged away! Back of a length delivery in the channel outside off, Peter pushes inside the line and gets a thick outside edge down to third man for a boundary.
Wide! Short ball down the leg side, Chase tries working it away but misses.
Good length ball on off, punched through mid off for a run.
Yorker outside off, Chase tries to drive but misses.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
Lands it full and outside off, Chase drives it through point for one.
Movement back into the batsman from a length around middle, Chase fails to keep it out and is hit on the thigh pad.
Straighter in line, tucked through mid-wicket for one.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full on off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Another attempted drive by Chase but he misses.
Lands it on a length and outside off, Chase stays back and pushes it straight to the cover fielder.
Bowls it full and outside off, Chase tries to drive but misses.
Back of a length delivery on off, Dockrell stays back and steers it through point for a run.
Peter Chase is the last man in.

OUT! Soft dismissal! Plunkett angles across a full length ball outside off, slower in place, Murtagh hangs back and is through with his shot very early. Ends up mistiming his shot in the air and Ball at backward point takes the catch safely again, his third this evening.
Short and outside off, Murtagh mistimes his flat-batted shot to covers for a single.
Slower full ball on off, Dockrell quietly plays it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
A cracking drive off the front foot by Dockrell but he finds the mid off fielder.
Angles in a short of a length ball from around the wicket, Murtagh swings his bat across the line and gets a top edge. It falls safely at third man for a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Shortish in length and straighter in line, George works it to square leg for one.
Length ball angling into the batsman, Dockrell turns it to mid-wicket for a run.
Tim Murtagh comes out to bat.

OUT! Gone! Plunkett serves a length delivery in the line of the stumps, McCarthy makes space for a big swing of his bat and goes through with his shot. However, it comes off from the toe end of the bat and flies over mid off. Ball backtracks from inside the circle and judges the skier to perfection. End is nigh for Ireland!
Plunkett bangs in a short ball, McCarthy is not sure what to do with it. Tries pulling at first but then sways away.
Dockrell guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Angles in a full ball on middle, Barry eases it to long on for a run.
Serves it on a good length and outside off, holding its line, McCarthy pushes inside the line and misses.
Liam Plunkett to have a bowl...
Fullish around off, shaping in. Dockrell covers the line and defends it.
Good length ball outside off, dabbed neatly to third man for a run.
Barry McCarthy is the new batsman.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Fuller length ball outside off, angles in. Porterfield shuffles across his stumps, crouches and looks to paddle scoop it towards fine leg. However, he hasn't executed it well and the ball thuds into the stumps. It was a poor shot selection with fine leg in place. He was playing so well in front of the wickets. Would be disappointed to depart in this manner but it has been a brilliant knock nonetheless.
Back of a length outside off, placed through point for a run.
Another short delivery and angling into Porterfield. Pulled in a controlled manner to deep square leg for a single.
Dug in short, William goes for the pull but fails to get any bat on it.
Mark Wood is back into the attack. 108 needed off 60 balls.
Powerplay 3 signalled! Maximum five fielders now allowed outside the circle.
Great take, Billings! Indipping yorker onto the boots. Brushes the outer half and flies towards the keeper. he dives to his left to make a brilliant stop.
Fuller length delivery outside off, William throws his bat at it and gets it through point for a run.

SIX! Launched! On a length this time, Porterfield slams it over mid-wicket and the ball seems to have cleared the fence. The umpires check whether it's a boundary or maximum. It has just landed on the ropes, so a maximum is signaled by the umpire. It has been a gem of a knock from the Irish skipper so far.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Well controlled! Dug in short on off, Dockrell swivels across and pulls it with authority through square leg. Gets another boundary to his name. 28 runs have come off the last 14 deliveries. Good momentum for the visitors.
Short of a length ball around the hips, swiped through square leg for a run.
SIX! Bang! Dockrell chips down the track to the tossed up delivery outside off and murders it over long on for a huge maximum. Rashid proves to be expensive today.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Porterfield works this to deep mid-wicket. Aggressive running between the wickets allows them to come back for the second.
FOUR! Beautiful! Uses his feet and goes inside out over covers against the spin. Does it really well and finds the fence.

In the air... but safe! Tossed up around the pads, Porterfield kneels, looks to sweep it across but gets a top edge that spoons just over short fine leg. The fielder goes back, puts in  a dive but fails to reach it. Two runs taken.
Backs away a lot and exposes his stumps. Manages to slap it to extra cover.
Drinks break.
FOUR! Wristy! Good length delivery outside off, Dockrell whips it over mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
Wide! Dug in short, Dockrell lets it go. Wide signalled for height.
On a fuller length and angling in sharply, Dockrell looks to play it across but gets an inside edge to it and the ball rolls to mid-wicket.
Porterfield shuffles across, takes a couple of steps down the track and pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Fullish outside off, stroked through covers for an easy run.
William taps this one beside the pitch and towards point. The batsmen take off for a run. Roy dives in front but his shy at the striker's end misses. Had he hit, it would have been close.
Shortish delivery angling in from outside off, Porterfield goes for the pull but fails to get any bat on it.
Porterfield brings out another sweep shot and finds the gap on the leg side for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. One run added to the total.
Full and on the pads, swept behind square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball on off, it's caressed down to long off for one.
Floated full ball on off, pushed with the spin to covers.
Flighted full ball around off, Porterfield reverse sweeps it to deep point for a single.
A little short in length and outside off, pushed from the back foot to point. Only one run from the over.
A well-directed bouncer, Dockrell ducks at the last moment.
Lands it full and outside off, George pushes it with an angled bat to point.
On a length and outside off, shaping back in a bit, Dockrell gets back and pushes it to covers.
Just a shade short in length on off, William pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Starts from around the wicket and angles in a length ball on off, Porterfield defends it back.
Jake Ball has the ball in his hand.
Flighted and outside off, left alone.
Nicely tossed up leg spinner around leg, Dockrell gets forward and defends it off the outer half of the bat to point.
Too full and on off, Porterfield gets forward and forces it down to long on for a run.
George Dockrell is the new man in.

OUT! The danger man departs! Rashid shows the courage to flight it around middle and off, it's full as it lands and O'Brien gets down to sweep it across the line. It flies off the top edge and Ball settles underneath it at backward square leg. He makes no mistake and Ireland are now staring down the barrel. 151 needed off 93 balls with four wickets remaining.
Short and on middle, Porterfield gets back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy full ball outside off, driven through covers for one.
Flatter on off, Kevin gets back and cuts it through cover-point for a run. Root is bowled out now, 10-0-52-3!
Kevin O'Brien has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drives a full ball through extra cover for a run.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for one.

SIX! Out of here! A flighted ball outside off, fuller in length, O'Brien shimmies down the track and thwacks it over extra cover for a maximum. He is a real danger man. While he is there, the run chase is on for Ireland.
Hits the blockhole, Porterfield pushes it back to the bowler.
Presses forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
SIX! Against the spin he goes but backs it up with immense power. Tossed up ball landing full around middle, O'Brien kneels and smokes it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Floated full ball on middle, William leans forward and eases it down to long on for a run.
Drops it short and on off, it's cut from the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Fullish on middle, drilled down to long on for a run.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Porterfield stays back and punches it towards Jason Roy at extra cover. He fumbles and concedes two runs. Sloppy work from him.
Kevin O'Brien arrives at number 7. 175 needed off 111 balls.

OUT! Wilson departs in an attempt to up the ante! Tossed up outside off and on a fullish length, Wilson reaches out to it and looks to go over covers. Ends up slicing it over cover-point. Alex Hales moves across to his right from deep point, judges it well and takes it safely. England continue to rule the roost in home conditions.

In the air... but safe! Slow through the air on middle and leg, Porterfield kneels, looks to sweep it through square leg but top edges it. The ball spoons towards short fine leg but falls short of Adil Rashid!
Reverse sweeps this one to point.
14th ODI fifty for William Porterfield!
Porterfield tucks this with the spin to mid-wicket for a single. A free flowing knock him and well deserved. Keeping his side in with a chance.
Down the leg side, swept down to fine leg for a run.
Fullish delivery around the pads, swept hard to fine leg for a single.
Stays back to the shorter length ball and cuts it towards point.
Fullish delivery, pushed to mid on.
Porterfield clips this one to wide mid on for a single.
Uses his feet to this one and defends it.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven sweetly through covers for a single.
Shortish outside off, Wilson goes for the cut but gets a bottom edge that goes through the legs of the keeper. A run taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short this time, cut through point for a run.
Nudges this one to the leg side for a single.

Dropped! Tossed up on leg stump, Porterfield looks to turn it across but is early into the shot. Gets a leading edge towards extra cover. Joe Root is perhaps a bit late to judge it. Goes across, dives and gets his right hand to it but fails to hold on.
Strides to the flighted delivery and defends it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
William sweeps it to the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Good adjustment! Slips this one down the leg side, Porterfield attemps to play the reverse sweep at first but makes the correct decision at the end. Paddles it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Tossed up in line of the stumps, driven back to the bowler.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Coming in with the arm from outside off, driven hard to extra cover.
Fullish on off, eased through mid on for a run.
A touch short outside off, punched off the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up outside off, reverse swept towards short third man for a single.
FOUR! Poor delivery and it is duly punished! Full toss around off, Porterfield strokes it in the gap in between mid off and extra cover and the ball whistles away to the fence.
Down the leg side, tickled to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Full toss on middle, milked to long off for a single.
Quicker one off, Gary camps back and pushes it down the track.
Tossed up outside off, spinning away. Wilson looks to cut it square of the wicket but gets beaten.
Tossed up on middle, whipped through wide mid on for a single.
Tucks it off his pads to mid-wicket. The non-striker wants a single but is sent back in time as the fielder scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. No harm done.
Lunges and defends it from the higher half of the bat.
Bowls a round-arm delivery and fires in a fuller one on off, Porterfield drives it down to long off for a single.
Loopy on off, defended back.
Defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted off spinner outside off, Wilson taps it down with soft hands towards short third man and takes a single.
Flighted and outside off, this time it's pushed through the gap at covers for a single.
Gets forward to a full ball and pushes it with the spin to covers.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. No run.
FOUR! Poor delivery, on the shorter side around middle, Wilson swivels and pulls it powerfully across the line. It goes on one bounce past the diving deep square leg fielder for a boundary.
Floated full ball on off, driven on the up but on one bounce to the cover fielder.
Tossed up ball outside leg, swept to fine leg for a single.
Fires a shorter one around middle and leg, Porterfield glances it aerially through square leg for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Beaten! Nicely flighted delivery outside off, fuller in length, Wilson tries to drive, expecting it to spin in but it skids through straight to beat the outside edge.
Shorter and flatter outside off, punched down to long off for a run.
Gary Wilson comes out to bat.

OUT! O'Brien holes out! He hit a six in Root's last over by advancing down the track and tries to repeat that shot. But this time he is not quite to the pitch of the ball and ends up mistiming it in the air. Willey at long on settles underneath it and does the rest. Another one bites the dust and the chase for Ireland continues to slide down.
Quicker slider on middle, Niall gets forward and plays it off the inside half of the bat to mid-wicket.
Flighted full ball on off, defended back to the bowler.
Turns it off his pads to square leg and rotates the strike.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Loopy full ball on middle, flicked quietly through square leg for a run.
Shortish on off, punched to long on for one.
Googly around off, Porterfield is foxed by the variation, tries to defend but it spins the other way to beat the outside edge.
Makes room by going deep inside the crease and hammers it through cover-point for a single.
Gets back to make room and slaps it to deep cover for one.
SIX! Wonderful footwork by Niall as he jumps out to the pitch of the delivery and launches it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Goes on the back foot and punches it through the gap at covers for one.
Flatter on off, punched to extra cover.
Tossed up ball on middle, forced down to long on for a run. 100 up for Ireland and it's met with a big round of applause from the Irish supporters in the crowd.
Floated delivery, turned to the leg side.

Short delivery around off, skidding through. Porterfield looks to pull it across but misses and the ball hits him on the stomach. There is a stifled appeal for an LBW but no interest from the umpire. Height was a factor and may be also the impact was just outside off.
Niall turns this one with the spin to mid-wicket for a run.
A touch short this time, cut to point.
A slip in place now.
Around the pads, worked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Shot! Tossed up outside off, Porterfield creams it through covers for an exquisite boundary.
Indeed it's spin from both ends now. Adil Rashid, the Man of the Match of the last game, is introduced into the attack.
Floated on middle, played down to long on for a single.
England might look to insert spin from both ends.
Fullish on middle and leg, eased to long on for a single.
Floated on off, pushed to extra cover.
Stays back to this one and punches this one nicely to sweeper cover for a couple.
Tossed up delivery, O'Brien looks to sweep it across but loses control of the bat. Gets an under edge onto it and the ball rolls away.
Tossed up around off, pushed to covers.
Wide! Wide outside off, left alone.
On a length outside off, slapped straight to extra cover. Successful over for the hosts.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
In the channel outside off, left alone.
Stays back to the good length delivery and defends it down the track.
Niall O'Brien is in next.

OUT! The visitors are in trouble now and the scoreboard pressure has started to tell on them! On a good length on off, angling in and stays low. Balbirnie goes deep in the crease but is foxed by the lack of bounce on it. Looks to play it across, is late on it and gets pinged on the front pad. The Englishmen go up in a confident appeal and up goes the umpire's dreaded finger. Andrew should have been on the front foot instead of going on the back foot. Pays the price for it and his short stay in the middle comes to an end.
Plunkett comes around the wicket and angles it around the hips, tucked to mid-wicket for an easy single.
Slow through the air on off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Porterfield stays leg side of the ball and eases it to long off for a run.
Driven straight to the man at mid off this time.
Another floated delivery outside off, this time William doesn't connect with the reverse sweep.
FOUR! Nice improvisation! Tossed up well outside off, Porterfield goes for the fancy reverse sweep and executes it well through short fine leg to find the fence.
Floated on middle, worked to short mid-wicket.

Time for Drinks. Ireland need 248 runs in 198 deliveries with 8 wickets in hand. The visitors are under pressure and it will need something special from them to stay in the contest. England will look to continue chipping away at the wickets and build pressure on the Irish batsmen.
Fractionally overpitched outside off, driven crispy back to Plunkett who bends to his left to make a good half-stop in his followthrough.
Full length delivery at good pace tailing in from outside off, Andrew puts his head down and blocks calmly. Plunkett is running in hard and is looking in much better rhythm in this game.
Porterfield stays back and punches this one to sweeper cover for a run.
Straying on the hips, tucked through backward square leg for a run.
Short of a length outside off, Andrew opens the face of his bat and taps it to point.
On a back of a length and angling into the hips. Balbirnie gets a bit of bat to it but it is near the left side of the keeper.
Similar delivery, pushed to mid off.
Fullish on off, driven to long on for a single.
Wide! Tossed up wide outside off, Balbirnie shuffles across and lets it go.
Andy Balbirnie is the new batsman.

OUT! Root strikes! Drags his length back and it comes in with the arm, Joyce goes deep in the crease and looks to force it through covers. Is completely beaten by the length and pace of the delivery to get his leg stump rattled. A scratchy knock from Ed Joyce comes to an end.
Fullish delivery, driven back to Root.
Straying on the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a run.
Ed dances down the track and milks it down to long off for a single.
Joe Root to bowl now.
Joyce places this one to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Porterfield punches it past the diving fielder at covers for a single.
In the channel outside off, William doesn't flirt with it.
Fullish delivery, driven to mid off.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They pick up a single.
Joyce drives this square of the wicket where Roy makes a good stop this time.
Shortish and width on offer, cut hard towards Bairstow at covers who makes a fine diving stop.
FOUR! Off the mark in style! Fractionally overpitched around of, William creams it through mid off for an exquisite boundary.
On a length outside off, left alone.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Fullish around off, Porterfield pushes it to extra cover. A bit of yes and no in the calling between the batsmen but no harm done.
William Porterfield comes out to bat.

OUT! Great call to take the review, Sam Billings! Short of a length outside off, holding its line. Stirling flashes at it hard and seems to have missed it. The ball flies into the gloves of Sam Billings who takes it and appeals. He is very confident that there is a nick. Morgan listens to him and takes the review. Time for the replays. There is no such sound in normal motion. However, the Snicko spots a nick as there is a spike on it. That is conclusive enough and Stirling has to walk back. He was looking so good out there, will be disappointed to miss out on a half century.
England take a review against Paul Stirling. Sam Billings is confident that there is a nick and convinces Morgan to go for the review.
Full length ball on off, driven to mid off who fumbles a touch but no harm done.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
On a length around off, Joyce is a bit early into his drive and mistimes it towards mid off. His bottom hand came off in the process.
Angling in towards the pads, nudged round the corner for a run.
Fullish delivery around off, pushed to extra cover.
Well bowled! Cross seam delivery outside off, Stirling goes for a booming drive but gets beaten.

In the air... but safe! Back of a length on off, Stirling looks to pull it across but it takes the splice of his bat. The ball spoons just over Mark Wood at mid on and falls safely. Mark misjudged it a bit perhaps. Single taken.
Length delivery outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Dug in short and it's angling into Paul. He pulls it hard through backward square leg and Bairstow near the fence cuts it off. Two runs taken.
On a driving length outside off, Stirling drills it but unfortunately it is straight to the man at cover-point.
An extra man at backward point now.
Short of a length outside off, angling in. He adjusts well to dab it to third man for a run.
Back of a length outside off, run down to third man for a single.
On a length around off, eased to covers off the front foot.
Fullish delivery on off, driven to mid off.
On a good length and leaving the southpaw. He points his bat skywards and allows it through.
Full length ball outside off, carved through cover-point for a run.
On a fuller length and angling away from Ed. He flashes at it but gets it uppishly off the outer half and on a bounce to third man. A single taken.
Wide! Plunkett gets his radar wrong and slips it down the leg side. Joyce looks to tuck it across but misses.
Fullish delivery slanting across Joyce. Driven to short cover.
Liam Plunkett is introduced into the attack. A slip in place.

Powerplay 2 time! Maximum four fielders allowed outside the ring. Ireland are off to a quickfire start. The platform is laid but now is the time for them to not throw it away. England will like to make a comeback in the middle overs. The spin of Adil Rashid will be the key as the Irishmen have often struggled against a leg spinner. Rashid Khan exposed them in an ODI series recently and Adil Rashid in the first ODI. Let's see how they fare today.
Shortish on off, defended from the back foot to cover-point.
Play and a miss! Length delivery outside off, Stirling flashes and misses.
Full ball on middle, defended back.
FOUR! Cracking shot! Short delivery again, wide outside off, Stirling rides the bounce and steers it past the diving point fielder for a boundary.
Shortish and outside off, Joyce runs it down to third man for a single.
Full and angling in around off, defended back to the bowler.
Short of a length delivery outside off, Stirling stands tall and hits it square of the wicket on the off side. The point fielder moves across to his right to make the stop.
Back of a length ball on middle, Joyce jumps and taps it down wide of mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish and off, driven from the front foot to the cover region. Not in the gap.
Good length ball angling away from the batsman, Joyce covers the line and allows it through to the keeper.
Fullish and around leg, pushed down to mid on.
Angles in a length ball on off, shaping in, Stirling gets forward to defend but it takes the inner half of the bat and runs through backward square leg for a single.
Angled into the batsman, Joyce has stood up on his toes to play that one.
Short around off, Stirling gets down the track and turns it on the leg side for a run. Nearly got into a tangle.
Fullish and on middle, Stirling gets behind the line and defends it to mid on. Paul is no stranger to this ground, has played plenty of county cricket here for Middlesex.
Shortish and outside off, slapped to point where the fielder dived to his right to make the stop. Cannot prevent the single.
Once again Joyce defends it off his back foot to the off side. It goes in the gap, Ed wants a run but is sent back.
Ball starts from around the wicket for the southpaw and delivers a length ball on off, Ed Joyce defends it from the crease.
Bowling change! Jake Ball replaces Willey in the attack.
Length on off, defended from the back foot to end an expensive over. 11 from this one!

SIX! Stirling is not backing away from the challenge! Wood delivers a back of a length ball on off, 90 mph, Stirling dispatches it with disdain over mid-wicket. Fighting fire with fire, Paul. Great battle to watch. 50 up for Ireland in no time.
Beaten! Length ball around off, very sharp at 91.2 mph, Stirling tries defending but is beaten for pace. Good reply from the bowler!
FOUR! Hit me delivery! Short and around off, Stirling rides the bounce and pulls it in front of square leg for a boundary. He is cruising.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. No run.
Full and outside off, pushed to extra cover where the fielder dived to make the stop. A single taken in the meantime.
Full and on off, punched to covers. 9 from the over.

Five wides! Willey tries to get his line straight but ends up spraying it down the leg side. Stirling fails to flick and the keeper fails to stop it with a full length dive to his left. A boundary at fine leg.
FOUR! No stopping this one. Willey overpitches outside off, there is some width on offer which is enough for Stirling. He played a punchy drive again and finds the gap at covers.

Roy saves a certain boundary! Willey errs in line and length, bowls it short and wide outside off, Stirling slaps it square of the wicket and Jason Roy at backward point dives full length to his dive to make a beautiful stop.
Darts in a full length ball on off, Stirling is forced to defend it back. This angle has stifled Paul's free flowing stroke play.
Hits the yorker mark on this occasion, on middle and leg, this time Stirling fails to keep it out cleanly. A stifled appeal for an lbw but nothing doing.
Willey continues from around the wicket angle and delivers a near yorker on off, Stirling digs it out to mid on.
Serves it on a length around middle and off, Ed gets squared up a bit and defends it off the outer half of the bat to cover-point.
Bowls it full and outside off, Joyce pushes it off his front foot to the cover fielder.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Gets behind the line of the delivery and defends it from the back foot.
Joyce has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

FOUR! Wood digs in a short ball around the rib cage, Joyce tries to glance it across the line by getting tall on the delivery but gloves it. It runs down very fine and finds the fence on the leg side.
Another inswinger into the batsman from around the wicket, Stirling doesn't have enough room to play with and just keeps it out to covers.
Offers a bit of width outside off, Paul mishits it to the off side. Probably picked the line a bit late.
Willey changes his angle and runs in from around the wicket. He fires in a full ball around off, shaping in, Stirling tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Back of a length ball on off, Joyce rises to play at it but gets an inside edge. It goes through his legs to square leg and they cross.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Ed allows it through watchfully.
Beaten! Willey bowls a lovely outswinger outside off, it's on a good length, Joyce feels for it and gets beaten.
Straighter delivery, Joyce bunts it down to mid on and scampers across to the other end. The fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. 10 from the over, Ireland off to a flier!
Short delivery, Stirling is early into the pull shot and hence misses. It goes off his body to the off side and they cross for a leg bye.
Good length delivery outside off, tapped down to point.
FOUR! Wood pitches it further up around off, Stirling plays a punchy drive and threads the gap between extra cover and mid off for a boundary. You get full value for your shots on this ground.
FOUR! Outstanding shot! Stirling looking in cracking touch. On a full length outside off, Paul unfurls a beautiful cover drive for a boundary.
Bowls it full and around middle, it's defended back with a straight bat.
Good line again, on a length around off, Joyce defends it from the back foot.
Around off on a length, Joyce defends it off his back foot.
Gets it nice and full this time, around middle, Stirling tucks it on the leg side, finds the gap and rotates the strike. Smart batting.
FOUR! Hat-trick of boundaries! Willey is not learning, bowls another half-tracker outside off, Stirling latches onto it and muscles it to the sweeper cover boundary.
FOUR! Dangerous played he is! Shortish again, around off, Paul shifts his weight on the back foot and plays a cracking pull in front of square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Bang! Willey is on the shorter side outside off, Stirling latches onto the room and slaps it through covers for a boundary.
David Willey to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
On a fuller length around middle and off, Joyce defends it from the crease to the off side. Good start by Wood!
On a driving length outside off, angling away from the batsman, Ed allows it through.
Pitches it up and outside off, Joyce drives it square of the wicket on the off side but straight to the fielder inside the ring. A slight fumble by the point fielder but no run taken.
Short and wide outside off, Stirling throws his bat at it but fails to middle it properly. Still it goes through the gap at covers and he takes a single to get off the mark.
A touch short and down the leg side, Joyce glances it off his hips to backward square leg and gets off the mark with a single. Ireland are away!
Starts with a gentle length delivery in the channel outside off, Joyce watches the line closely before leaving it.
Back for the run chase! Ed Joyce and Paul Stirling are the openers for Ireland. It's going to be Mark Wood to begin proceedings with the ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...
